condition: An inner or left join on a float key whose left frame is flagged sorted ascending uses the sorted-merge fast path, which compares keys with IEEE ==, so NaN keys fail to match NaN rows on the other side.
workaround: Drop the sorted flag before joining, e.g. by joining in a lazy query where the sort happens (left.lazy().sort(...).join(...)) or by using the streaming engine. You can also replace NaN keys with a sentinel value before the join.
